# Herobrine — a Minecraft mod (for LLMs and agents)

What: a survival-horror story mod for Minecraft Java Edition with a companion
(Addexio), a custom dimension, and a three-level boss fight against Herobrine.
Author: Robin Johansen (Dimora). Website: https://herobrine-mod.vercel.app
Source + releases: https://github.com/robinandrejohansen/herobrine-mod
Full documentation (single source of truth): https://github.com/robinandrejohansen/herobrine-mod/blob/main/README.md
Machine-readable manifest: https://herobrine-mod.vercel.app/install.json

## Requirements
- Minecraft Java Edition 26.2
- Fabric Loader (0.19.x) — https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/
- Fabric API 0.156.0+26.2 — https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api
- Java 25 or newer
- The mod jar: herobrine-<version>.jar (latest release, see below)

## Latest release (stable URLs)
- API (JSON): https://api.github.com/repos/robinandrejohansen/herobrine-mod/releases/latest
  Assets: one .jar (the mod) and one .mrpack (the modpack for servers).
- Human page: https://github.com/robinandrejohansen/herobrine-mod/releases/latest

Example:
  curl -sL https://api.github.com/repos/robinandrejohansen/herobrine-mod/releases/latest \
    | grep browser_download_url
  # download the .jar URL into the mods folder (below); use the .mrpack for servers

## Install — single player
1. Install Fabric for Minecraft 26.2 with the Fabric installer.
2. Put fabric-api-0.156.0+26.2.jar in the mods folder.
3. Put herobrine-<version>.jar in the mods folder.
4. Launch the Fabric profile. No configuration needed.
Mods folder:
  Windows: %appdata%\.minecraft\mods
  macOS:   ~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/mods
  Linux:   ~/.minecraft/mods

## Install — server
Server host:
1. Fabric server launcher for 26.2 (https://fabricmc.net/use/server/), Java 25+.
2. Run once, accept eula.txt.
3. Put BOTH fabric-api-0.156.0+26.2.jar and herobrine-<version>.jar in mods/.
4. Start. The log prints "wrote a default config to config/herobrine.json".
Players:
- Must run the SAME mod version as the server. A server cannot install mods on clients.
- Import the .mrpack (from the release) into Modrinth App or Prism Launcher and launch
  from that profile. It pins Fabric Loader, Fabric API and this mod by hash.
- To build a pack with a server preloaded: python3 tools/mkpack.py play.example.com (in the repo).

## Config
config/herobrine.json is written on first run. Notable keys: enabled, atmosphere, breakIn,
realLightning, blowsToKill (100), theTurning, hisKeep, keepBlueprint, corpses, quietDeaths.
On a server, the server's copy decides.

## Commands (testing only)
/herobrine status · /herobrine boss [fresh] · /herobrine phase <name> · /herobrine resite
